title: Emit complete constraint rules before certifying prompt coverage
context: Truncated constraint statements could omit prohibitions, and clipped scope lists could omit files, preventing task briefs from certifying actual coverage.
decision: When constraintTargets is nonempty, render unserved constraints with complete statements and scope lists before certifying prompt coverage. Preserve existing clipping otherwise and for previously served references.
consequences: Prompt delivery can certify coverage while including the full blocking rule and scope list.
Constraint output can be longer when prompt targets are supplied.
Relevance and provenance for decisions and other records remain unchanged.
alternatives_rejected: Keep truncating prompt constraints and require a detail lookup before certifying coverage.

rejected_tripwires.alternative: Keep truncating prompt constraints and require a detail lookup before certifying coverage.
